ai.title: Register a transaction
ai.intro: Tell us what you received or spent. Use a message, a list, or groups by date, account or category. Review the details before registering.
ai.example: For example: Gasté 35 mil en almuerzo
ai.review: Review the details and make any changes before confirming.
ai.selectMissing: Complete the missing fields to continue.
ai.cancelled: Registration cancelled. No transaction was saved.

errors.unavailable: We could not prepare your transaction. Try again or register the transaction manually.
errors.model: We could not prepare your transaction. Try again or register the transaction manually.
errors.timeout: The request took too long. You can try again or register the transaction manually.
errors.invalid: We could not interpret the message. You can edit it or register the transaction manually.
errors.unsupported: This record belongs to an operation handled in its own section, such as transfers, savings or liability payments.
errors.context: We could not prepare a transaction for this message. You can register the transaction manually.
errors.inactive: This registration expired or is no longer available. Send the message again to continue.
errors.consumed: This registration has already been used. Check your transactions before registering another.
errors.reference: Check the selected account and category; one is unavailable or does not match the transaction type.
errors.balance: The amount exceeds what the account balance allows. Check the account and amount.
errors.concurrent: The balance changed during registration. Review the details and try again.
errors.disabled: Registration by message is unavailable right now. You can register the transaction manually.
errors.generic: We could not complete the request. Check your connection and try again.
errors.localOnly: Registration by message is unavailable right now. You can register the transaction manually.
errors.interrupted: The request was interrupted. You can try again when you are ready to continue.
errors.validation: Review the proposed details before continuing.
errors.clarification: It is not clear how to register this part of the message. You can discard it and describe it again with the missing details.
errors.tooLarge: The message contains more records than we can prepare together. You can share them in smaller messages.

ai.welcome: Register your income and expenses with a message
ai.slow: We are still preparing your records. You can keep waiting or use the manual form.
ai.historyHint: Messages survive reloads in this tab and clear when you sign out.
ai.scopeHint: Share one or more income, expense or credit-purchase records. You will review the details before registering them.
ai.pendingHint: Confirm or cancel to register another transaction.
ai.pendingUncertainHint: Check this registration before starting another transaction.
ai.saveUncertain: We could not confirm whether the transaction was saved. Retry registration with these same details to avoid registering it twice.
ai.liabilityHint: This adds to the account’s liabilities. Your available balance will stay the same.
ai.storageUnavailable: We could not save this chat in this tab. You can continue, but messages will be lost on reload.
